lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: The part that bothers me is that nobody owns the decision any more. And I don't mean the machine owns it. I mean nobody does. Not the machine, not me, not the man who signs for the floor.

lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: There's a man comes through twice a year and signs for the whole building. Pleasant enough. I could not tell you who he works for, and I have asked. That is who owns it, and he is never in the room when anything is actually decided, and neither is anyone else.
